mapper.select: SELECT u.ID AS "corpUserId", u.USER_ID AS "userId", su.NAME AS "userName", g.ID AS "groupId", g.CORP_ACCT_GRP_ID AS "acctGroupId", m.WF_ROLE_CD AS "wfRoleCd", m.APRV_LVL_CD AS "aprvLvlCd", u.AUTH_TYP_CD AS "authTypCd" FROM CORP_USR u JOIN CORP_USR_GRP g ON g.ID = u.CORP_USR_GRP_ID AND g.CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND g.IS_DELETE = N'N' LEFT JOIN GCM_ST_APRV_MAP m ON m.ID = u.APRV_MAP_ID LEFT JOIN SPI_GE_USER su ON su.CD = u.SPI_USR_CD WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT b.MIN_AMT_LMT AS "minAmtLmt", b.MAX_AMT_LMT AS "maxAmtLmt" FROM BANK_TRX_LMT b JOIN COM_ST_SRVC_CCY_MTRX scm ON scm.ID = b.SRVC_CCY_MTRX_ID JOIN COM_ST_SRVC_CCY scy ON scy.ID = scm.SRVC_CCY_ID WHERE scy.SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd} AND b.CCY_CD = #{ccyCd} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT u.ID AS "corpUserId", u.USER_ID AS "userId", su.NAME AS "userName", g.ID AS "groupId", m.WF_ROLE_CD AS "wfRoleCd", m.APRV_LVL_CD AS "aprvLvlCd" FROM CORP_USR u JOIN CORP_USR_GRP g ON g.ID = u.CORP_USR_GRP_ID AND g.CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND g.IS_DELETE = N'N' JOIN GCM_ST_APRV_MAP m ON m.ID = u.APRV_MAP_ID LEFT JOIN SPI_GE_USER su ON su.CD = u.SPI_USR_CD

SELECT d.SEQ_NO AS "seqNo", d.NO_USR AS "noUsr", s.APRV_LVL_CD AS "aprvLvlCd", d.USR_GRP_OPT AS "usrGrpOpt", d.CORP_USR_GRP_ID AS "corpUsrGrpId" FROM CORP_APRV_MTRX_DTL d LEFT JOIN AUTH_LMT_SCHEME s ON s.ID = d.AUTH_LMT_SCHEME_ID WHERE d.CORP_APRV_MTRX_SUB_ID = #{bandId} ORDER BY d.SEQ_NO

SELECT v.ID AS "id", v.AMT_LMT_USAGE AS "amtLmtUsage", v.MAX_AMT_LMT AS "maxAmtLmt" FROM CORP_LMT_PC_DTL v JOIN COM_ST_SRVC_CCY_MTRX scm ON scm.ID = v.SRVC_CCY_MTRX_ID JOIN COM_ST_SRVC_CCY scy ON scy.ID = scm.SRVC_CCY_ID WHERE v.CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND scy.SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd} AND v.CCY_CD = #{ccyCd} AND ROWNUM = 1 FOR UPDATE OF v.AMT_LMT_USAGE

mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id", CD AS "cd", NM AS "nm", MEMBER_CD AS "memberCd", ONLINE_CD AS "onlineCd", BIFAST_CD AS "bifastCd" FROM COM_MT_DOM_BANK WHERE ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETE = N'N'

SELECT ID AS "id", CD AS "cd", NM AS "nm", MEMBER_CD AS "memberCd", ONLINE_CD AS "onlineCd", BIFAST_CD AS "bifastCd" FROM COM_MT_DOM_BANK WHERE IS_DELETE = N'N' AND REGEXP_LIKE(CD, '^[0-9]{7}$') AND MEMBER_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NM

SELECT ID AS "id", CD AS "cd", NM AS "nm", MEMBER_CD AS "memberCd", ONLINE_CD AS "onlineCd", BIFAST_CD AS "bifastCd" FROM COM_MT_DOM_BANK WHERE IS_DELETE = N'N' AND (MEMBER_CD IS NOT NULL OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(CD, '^[0-9]+$')) ORDER BY NM
SELECT ID AS "id", CD AS "cd", NM AS "nm", MEMBER_CD AS "memberCd", ONLINE_CD AS "onlineCd", BIFAST_CD AS "bifastCd" FROM COM_MT_DOM_BANK WHERE IS_DELETE = N'N' AND ONLINE_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NM

SELECT ID AS "id", CD AS "cd", NM AS "nm", MEMBER_CD AS "memberCd", ONLINE_CD AS "onlineCd", BIFAST_CD AS "bifastCd" FROM COM_MT_DOM_BANK WHERE IS_DELETE = N'N' AND NVL(IS_INACTIVE, N'N') = N'N' AND BIFAST_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NM
